# Hermetic dossier-source v1 fixture

This directory contains generalized test data derived from the external
dossier-source contract. It is intentionally free of personal identities,
original/private repository coordinates, and deployment topology. Generalized
example repository locators and URLs remain where the contract shape requires
them.

`index.yaml` includes only the entries needed by Scout's readiness and
projection tests. The corresponding `summaries/<id>.yaml` files preserve the
contract shape and enough representative data to exercise minimum-entry,
prohibition, and evidence-resolution behavior. No schema or conformance-corpus
copy is vendored here.

`PROVENANCE` records the source revision and makes clear that the fixture is a
generalized derivative rather than a byte-for-byte export.
